data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They accurately delivered their tax rate guidance for FY26. However, they abandoned long-term revenue aspirations quickly, failing to mention the $2 billion FY27 goal after Q2 FY26 and dropping it, while the $5 billion FY31 goal is inconsistently repeated.

lines.line: Aspiration to reach $2 billion by FY27 was dropped without completion.
Aspiration of $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31 is on track.
Effective Tax Rate for FY26 promised at 20% to 24% was delivered at 22.6%.
